recipes.name: Classic Avocado Toast
instructions: Toast the sourdough slice until golden and crisp.
In a small bowl, mash the avocado with a squeeze of lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Spread the mashed avocado evenly over the toast.
Sprinkle with red pepper flakes and an optional drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.name: Quinoa Salad Bowl
instructions: Rinse quinoa and boil in 2 cups of water; reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes.
While quinoa cools, dice the cucumber and halve the cherry tomatoes.
Combine cooled quinoa, vegetables, and crumbled feta in a large bowl.
Toss with olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.

recipes.name: Spicy Garlic Shrimp
instructions: Peel and devein the shrimp, then pat them dry with paper towels.
Mince the garlic cloves finely.
Heat chili oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sauté the garlic for 1 minute.
Add shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes per side until pink and opaque.
Garnish with freshly chopped parsley and serve.

recipes.name: Berry Smoothie
instructions: Place the frozen mixed berries and sliced banana into a blender.
Add almond milk and a teaspoon of honey for sweetness.
Blend on high speed until the texture is completely smooth.
Pour into a chilled glass and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Mushroom Risotto
instructions: Warm the vegetable broth in a pot and keep it at a low simmer.
Sauté sliced mushrooms in a large pan until browned, then remove and set aside.
Toast Arborio rice in the same pan with a bit of oil for 2 minutes.
Add the warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring constantly until absorbed.
Once rice is creamy and tender, stir back in the mushrooms and parmesan cheese.

recipes.name: Caprese Skewers
instructions: Wash the cherry tomatoes and fresh basil leaves.
Thread one tomato, one folded basil leaf, and one mozzarella ball onto a small skewer.
Repeat the process until all ingredients are used.
Arrange on a platter and drizzle generously with balsamic glaze before serving.

recipes.name: Chickpea Curry
instructions: Sauté onions and garlic in a pot until soft.
Stir in curry powder for 1 minute to release the aroma.
Add drained chickpeas and coconut milk; simmer on low for 15 minutes.
Stir in fresh spinach and cook just until it wilts.
Serve hot with basmati rice or naan bread.

recipes.name: Greek Yogurt Parfait
instructions: Spoon a layer of Greek yogurt into the bottom of a glass or bowl.
Add a layer of crunchy granola and a handful of blueberries.
Repeat the layers once more.
Top with chopped walnuts and an optional drizzle of honey.

recipes.name: Beef Tacos
instructions: Cook ground beef in a skillet over medium heat until fully browned; drain excess fat.
Stir in taco seasoning and a splash of water, simmering for 5 minutes.
Warm the taco shells in the oven at 180°C for 2-3 minutes.
Fill shells with beef and top with shredded lettuce and cheddar cheese.

recipes.name: Pesto Pasta
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook pasta according to package directions.
Reserve 1/2 cup of pasta water before draining.
In a large bowl, mix the hot pasta with basil pesto, adding pasta water to reach desired consistency.
Toss in halved cherry tomatoes and toasted pine nuts.

recipes.name: Banana Pancakes
instructions: In a bowl, mash the bananas until very few lumps remain.
Whisk in the eggs and a pinch of baking powder until well combined.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium-low heat with a little butter or oil.
Pour small amounts of batter and cook for 2 minutes per side until golden brown.
Serve with maple syrup and fresh fruit.

recipes.name: Tomato Basil Soup
instructions: Sauté diced onion and minced garlic in a pot until translucent.
Add canned crushed tomatoes and a cup of vegetable broth; bring to a simmer.
Let it simmer for 20 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Add fresh basil leaves and use an immersion blender to process until smooth.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.name: Honey Glazed Salmon
instructions: Whisk together honey, soy sauce, and grated ginger to create the glaze.
Season salmon with salt and sear in a hot oven-safe pan for 3 minutes.
Flip the salmon and pour the glaze over the top.
Transfer the pan to an oven preheated to 200°C and bake for 5-8 minutes until flaky.

recipes.name: Caprese Salad
instructions: Slice the Roma tomatoes and fresh mozzarella into 1/2-inch thick rounds.
On a large plate, alternate slices of tomato and mozzarella.
Tuck fresh basil leaves between the layers.
Drizzle with high-quality olive oil and a sprinkle of sea salt.

recipes.name: Chicken Stir-Fry
instructions: Slice the chicken breast into thin bite-sized strips.
Stir-fry chicken in a hot wok until cooked through, then remove.
Add broccoli florets and sliced bell peppers to the wok; cook until tender-crisp.
Return chicken to the pan and toss with soy sauce and a touch of sesame oil.
Serve immediately over steamed rice.

recipes.name: Ceviche Peruano
instructions: Boil the sweet potato and corn until tender, then let them cool.
Cut the fresh fish into 2cm cubes and place in a glass bowl.
Season with salt, minced aji limo, and freshly squeezed lime juice; stir gently.
Let the fish 'cook' in the acid for 5-10 minutes.
Add thinly sliced red onions and serve with the sweet potato and corn.

recipes.name: Lomo Saltado
instructions: Prepare a batch of crispy french fries and keep them warm.
Sear the beef strips in a very hot wok or skillet until browned.
Add thick slices of onion and tomato, stir-frying for 2 minutes.
Deglaze the pan with soy sauce and vinegar.
Toss the french fries into the mix at the last second and serve with white rice.

recipes.name: Aji de Gallina
instructions: Poach chicken breast, let it cool, and shred it by hand.
Blend soaked bread with milk and aji amarillo paste until smooth.
Sauté onions and garlic, then add the yellow chili cream and simmer.
Stir in shredded chicken, chopped pecans, and parmesan cheese.
Serve over boiled potato slices with a side of white rice.

recipes.name: Causa Limeña
instructions: Boil and mash the yellow potatoes while hot until very smooth.
Once cool, mix the potato with lime juice, oil, and aji amarillo paste.
Prepare a filling of tuna or chicken mixed with mayonnaise.
In a ring mold, layer the potato dough, then sliced avocado, then the meat filling.
Finish with a final layer of potato and garnish with a boiled egg slice.

recipes.name: Papa a la Huancaína
instructions: Boil the potatoes, peel them, and slice them into thick rounds.
In a blender, combine queso fresco, aji amarillo (seeded), milk, and crackers.
Blend until the sauce is completely smooth and creamy.
Pour the sauce over the cold potato slices.
Garnish with a hard-boiled egg and a black botija olive.
